data.statement: The enriched-catalog bridge produced a fresher and more visually authored direction than another mug or desk-toy scene: the exact chicken-shaped ceramic form creates a formal-dinner/floral contradiction while remaining truthful at small centerpiece scale. One strict identity reference plus explicit anti-flesh constraints preserved ceramic material and avoided the eye-rug and oversized-goat failure modes.
data.decision: Shortlist attempt-v6-raw-chicken-1 as the run's only survivor and do not generate a cosmetic revision for minor non-gating simplifications.
data.nextAction: Present the complete Weird Home Decor publishing package to Cameron for exact approval or rejection; without an approval event, leave the production API untouched.
